sources.name: Carbon Valley Regional Library (High Plains Library District), LibCal
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. One branch serves all three towns: 7 Park Avenue, Firestone (Mon to Thu 9 am to 8 pm, Fri and Sat 10 am to 5 pm, Sun 1 to 5 pm, per mylibrary.us/locations-and-hours/). The district's LibCal is the same one the Windsor and Johnstown work found: its public iCal (ical_subscribe.php?src=p&cid=8181) is the district's 500 oldest items, 4 August to 25 September 2026 on 5 October, and no parameter (cal, cm, inc, d, t) narrows it to the branch or moves it forward, re-tested three ways. The district-wide RSS (rss.php?iid=4057&m=month&cid=8181; m=upcoming answers "invalid mode") does carry the coming fortnight, 300 items on 5 October of which 19 were at the Carbon Valley Regional Library (Drop-in Chess, English Class, Tween Craft Club, Sketch Club, Page Turner's Book Club), but its dates, times and building are inside each item's description, which the repo's RSS reader does not read (it reads CivicPlus's calendarEvent elements), so ingest would stage nothing from it: reading LibCal RSS would be a new feed reader, which is a feature to ask about. Until then the branch's calendar page, linked above with the building preselected, is read in a browser. robots.txt names a 10-second crawl delay for everyone and disallows the /process_ endpoints the page loads events from, so the page cannot be read by script either. The locationFilter is set for the day a reader exists. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's. Read as RSS from 5 October 2026: scripts/lib/feeds/rss.ts now reads LibCal's own libcal:date, libcal:time, libcal:location and libcal:campus elements (the district-wide feed covers the coming fortnight or so, 300 items on 5 October), and the locationFilter keeps the branch's. Exclusions set 5 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (routine meetings, the court and office closures are not events), at the owner's direction that the sources be settled on the editor's judgment; remove any to have it staged again. Storytimes, clubs, drop-ins, the English class and the advisory board are excluded; what remains is the one-off programs (a science afternoon, a teen improv session, an adult D&D one-shot, a 3D-modelling class). The feed marks a called-off session by prefixing "Cancelled:" to the title, as Longmont's does. The branch is in Firestone, so staged items carry subTown firestone. Excluded on 5 October 2026 at the review: "Let’s Draw!" and "Science Fun", monthly after-school sessions for elementary pupils (a class in all but name, under the event standard). "Ageless Grace" was already excluded; its cancelled session reached staging because the feed wrote a non-breaking space in the title, which the readers now treat as a space. Feed narrowed on 5 October 2026 to the branch with cam=4554 (the calendar's own building filter): 62 items, all at Carbon Valley, reaching about a month ahead where the district feed's 300 reach a fortnight. The locationFilter stays as a guard. Further exclusions on 5 October 2026, with the branch feed: the baby storytime (Twinkle Babies), the job-help drop-in, the legal clinic, Library 101, the monthly Paws to Read, make-and-take craft classes (Cricut, tote bags, looming), as Longmont excludes them, and the bird walk at Golden Ponds, which is in Longmont.
